title: Redox State and Genome-Wide Base Substitution Analysis
summary: This cluster is centered around the relationship between redox states and genome-wide base substitution analysis. High DO is associated with several methods, including C > A, C > G, and T > G, and is enriched in detoxification, oxidoreductase activity, and redox-buffering-associated pathways. Low DO, on the other hand, is associated with C > A, C > G, and T > G, and is enriched in cytoplasmic translation, protein synthesis, rRNA processing, ribosomal subunit assembly, and ribosome biogenesis. Genome-Wide Base Substitution Analysis is involved in several processes, including mismatches, SBS-6, and variants.
